content: Good, I have a solid shape. Now let me create a comprehensive FEM analysis setup script that includes all the required components: material AlZn4-5Mg1F35, 20 MN force, 3D Gmsh mesh with max 5mm and min 0.5mm, CalculiX solver, and the warp vector filter.

function.arguments:
{"script": "cd /home/user && python3 << 'EOF'
import FreeCAD
import Part
import Fem
import Mesh
import MeshPart

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open('/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd')
print("Document opened:", doc.Name)

# Get the body for FEM analysis
body = None
for obj in doc.Objects:
    if obj.TypeId == 'PartDesign::Body':
        body = obj
        break

if not body:
    print("ERROR: No Body found!")
    exit(1)

print(f"Using Body: {body.Name}")

# Create FEM document (analysis container)
analysis = Fem.createFemAnalysis("Analysis")
doc.addObject(analysis)

# Create material object - AlZn4-5Mg1F35
material = Fem.Material()
material.Name = "AlZn4-5Mg1F35"
material.Density = 2800  # kg/m^3 for aluminum alloy
material.PoissonRatio = 0.33
material.ElasticModulus = 71000000000  # 71 GPa in Pa
# Add to document
material_obj = doc.addObject("Fem::MaterialSolid", "Material_AlZn4_5Mg1F35")
material_obj.Material = material
doc.addObject(material_obj)

# Assign material to analysis
analysis.Material = material_obj

# Create FEM object from the body shape
fem_object = Fem.makeConstraintFixed("Displacement")
# Actually we need to create a FEM mesh first

# Let's create the mesh using Gmsh settings
print("\nCreating mesh...")

# First, create a FEMMeshGmsh object
mesh_gmsh = doc.addObject("Fem::FemMeshGmsh", "Mesh_Gmsh")
mesh_gmsh.ElementDimension = "3D"
mesh_gmsh.MeshSizeFromCurvature = 20
mesh_gmsh.MeshSizeMax = 5.0  # Maximum size 5 mm
mesh_gmsh.MeshSizeMin = 0.5  # Minimum size 0.5 mm
mesh_gmsh.GeoLengthUnit = "mm"

# Set the shape to mesh (the body)
mesh_gmsh.Shape = [body]

# Create constraint fixed (support) - fix one face
# We need to identify faces of the body
shape = body.Shape
print(f"\nBody has {len(shape.Faces)} faces")

# Create a fixed constraint on one face (e.g., bottom face)
fixed_constraint = doc.addObject("Fem::ConstraintFixed", "FixedSupport")
# Find a face to fix - typically the one with minimum Z
min_z_face = None
min_z = float('inf')
for face in shape.Faces:
    center = face.CenterOfMass
    if center.z < min_z:
        min_z = center.z
        min_z_face = face

if min_z_face:
    fixed_constraint.Surfaces = [(body, shape.Faces.index(min_z_face) + 1)]
    print(f"Fixed constraint applied to face at Z={min_z:.2f}")

# Create force constraint - 20 MN = 20,000,000 N
# Apply to opposite face (top face)
max_z_face = None
max_z = float('-inf')
for face in shape.Faces:
    center = face.CenterOfMass
    if center.z > max_z:
        max_z = center.z
        max_z_face = face

force_value = 20000000  # 20 MN in Newtons
force_constraint = doc.addObject("Fem::ConstraintForce", "Force_20MN")
if max_z_face:
    force_constraint.Surfaces = [(body, shape.Faces.index(max_z_face) + 1)]
    force_constraint.Force = force_value
    force_constraint.Direction = (0, 0, -1)  # Force direction
    print(f"Force constraint applied to face at Z={max_z:.2f}, magnitude={force_value} N")

# Add objects to analysis
analysis.Group = [mesh_gmsh, material_obj, fixed_constraint, force_constraint]

print("\nFEM Analysis setup complete!")
print(f"Analysis objects: {[obj.Name for obj in analysis.Group]}")

# Save intermediate state
doc.saveAs('/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd')
print("\nDocument saved as Unnamed.FCStd")

# Print document info
print("\nAll objects in document:")
for obj in doc.Objects:
    print(f"  {obj.Name}: {obj.TypeId}")
EOF"}

function.arguments:
{"script": "cat > /tmp/setup_fem.py << 'PYEOF'
import FreeCAD
import Part
import Mesh
import MeshPart
import os

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open('/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd')
print("Document opened:", doc.Name)

# Get the body for FEM analysis
body = None
for obj in doc.Objects:
    if obj.TypeId == 'PartDesign::Body':
        body = obj
        break

if not body:
    print("ERROR: No Body found!")
    exit(1)

print(f"Using Body: {body.Name}")

# Get the shape from the body
shape = body.Shape
print(f"Shape type: {shape.ShapeType}")

# Export shape to STEP file for Gmsh
step_file = '/tmp/body.step'
Part.export([body], step_file)
print(f"Exported shape to {step_file}")

# Create Gmsh script for 3D mesh with specified sizes
gmsh_script = '''
SetFactory("OpenCASCADE");
Merge "/tmp/body.step";

// Set mesh sizes
Mesh.CharacteristicLengthMin = 0.5;
Mesh.CharacteristicLengthMax = 5.0;

// Generate 3D mesh
Mesh 3;

// Output mesh in UNV format (for CalculiX)
Save "/tmp/mesh.unv";
'''

gmsh_file = '/tmp/mesh.geo'
with open(gmsh_file, 'w') as f:
    f.write(gmsh_script)

print(f"Created Gmsh script: {gmsh_file}")

# Run Gmsh
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['gmsh', '-3', gmsh_file], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Gmsh stdout:", result.stdout)
print("Gmsh stderr:", result.stderr)
print("Gmsh return code:", result.returncode)

# Check if mesh was created
if os.path.exists('/tmp/mesh.unv'):
    print("Mesh file created successfully")
    # Read mesh info
    with open('/tmp/mesh.unv', 'r') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
        print(f"Mesh file has {len(lines)} lines")
else:
    print("Mesh file NOT created")

# List all objects in document
print("\nAll objects in document:")
for obj in doc.Objects:
    print(f"  {obj.Name}: {obj.TypeId}")
PYEOF

FreeCADCmd /tmp/setup_fem.py 2>&1"}
